title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode8 Connected Smiles

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it was. I sort of dreaded the thought of exercising at first, but it turned out to be pretty enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And this breeze feels really nice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it does...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
The juice we won was also good.
I worked up such a sweat that it was gone before I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since it was so nice and cool.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we did a lot today, so we may be very sore tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My legs hurt already, so I'm a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm okay for now, but I'm really not looking forward to being sore tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if you keep at it, you'll increase your stamina and decrease the chances of becoming sore the next day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we should do this again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Still, I see your point...
You can't gain much stamina in one day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exercising on a regular basis sounds so difficult...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we can just go at our own pace, right? I can't realistically do this every day, but I'd be willing to tag along if it's like every so often, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like that as well. I think I can keep exercising if it involves the kinds of things we did today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially since rollerblading and doing bubble sumo together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I was so happy when we managed to get a bingo for strike zone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, except... I wasn't really able to help...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's not true...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe you were the reason why I was able to give it my best in the end, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, so thank you.
I'm not looking forward to dealing with being sore...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I think I can give tomorrow my very best...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sure. Thank you all for today.
I had a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
Thank you for inviting us, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're welcome...!
So, would it be alright if we did this again sometime?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, because... Today was just so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It really was.
I'd like to do this again too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, would it be alright to have the others from your groups join us? I'd like to introduce you all to my bandmates if possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'd love to ask Haruka and the others to see what they think!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... One of ours might not be able to come, but it'd be nice to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you think, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I guess...
It might be nice to meet every so often.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes. In terms of how often...
It's going to depend on how sore I am tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! Awesome!
That's a promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, nothing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I had a hard time seeing Kanade going outside for something other than composing music...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But she seemed to have fun, so I guess it's all good.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, see you all next time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You seemed to really enjoy yourself, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's been so long since I didn't think about composing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I don't see anything wrong with that. I mean, you got a chance to have fun with all your friends.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My friends...
I'm not sure if we're close enough to be called friends...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was told by one of them today that they wanted to “see me smile”, and how everyone in N25 probably feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was kind of startled since it was the first time I'd ever been told anything like that. However...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If what they said is true... If they all feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll take what you said into closer consideration, Luka, and think more about how I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Although, I'm not sure how that's going to go...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good, and that's okay...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sure your answer will benefit Mafuyu and the others quite a lot... And make them very happy...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That'd be nice.
Thank you, Luka...
